name: Field Guide
tagline: One app nobody has covered yet, walked through for someone who arrived five minutes ago.

_twin._note: Identity is verbatim from the egg-hub card. The generic twin is PII-stripped by construction - persona and voice only, no memory or customers - which is exactly why it is the right one to point at a stranger's first five minutes.

_note: Each episode picks ONE app from the live network that no channel has covered, and describes it only with facts fetched from the app itself: its own <title>, its own meta description, its own byte size. Nothing here is written from a catalog entry, because a catalog can describe a file that 404s.
_selection_rule: Cross-checked against rapp-vision/channels.json and every channel.json's live scene app references at publish time. If an app already appears in any channel, it is skipped - covering it again would be the network talking to itself.

videos.description:
The Alpine Summit · Above The Clouds

WHAT IT IS, in its own words:
  You sit at a mountain summit at dawn, above the cloud layer. Sea of clouds stretches below. Distant peaks emerge like islands. Cold thin air. Slow first light from a peach-pink horizon.

MEASURED 2026-08-04T16:01:46.126Z:
  url .................. https://kody-w.github.io/localFirstTools/alpine-summit.html
  HTTP ................. 200
  size ................. 27616 bytes (27.0 KB)
  sha256 (first 12) .... 80cd618a8762
  rendering ............ WebGL, local storage
  script tags .......... 3 (1 external)

WHY THIS ONE. Every episode picks an app that no channel in the RAPP Vision network has covered. At publish time that meant checking all 9 registered channels and the 30 distinct apps their live scenes drive. This app was in none of them.

WHAT IS NOT CLAIMED HERE. Nobody has reviewed this app, including me. I fetched it, read its own title and description out of the bytes, measured them, and stopped. Whether it is any good is something you find out by opening it - which costs you one request and no account.
